title: JIN: Kakutoha Oden
synonyms: Jin: Legend of the Dipper Style Destruction King
synopsis: In the not-too-distant future... In a society where corruption has spread and dreams and hopes have disappeared, an illegal, no-rules underground fighting sport called "Yaoyorozu" has thrived. Brutal street fights are waged anywhere and everywhere, driven by money and human desire. Jin Matsuya, a delinquent who repeatedly steals from the city, gets caught up in the violence. However, his qualities as a fighter are overwhelming... A new generation of spectacular battle action begins, where an extraordinary monster destroys everything! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
titleEnglish: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
synonyms: Reincarnation of a Wicked Woman's Dark Past
The Dark Past of a Reincarnated Villainess
synopsis: Konoha Satou has a dark history. After all, she spent her teen years writing self-indulgent fantasy romance fics-like her Dark History. But since she’s become its most despicable villainess, remembering every last detail is now a matter of life-and-death. Having avoided the first couple of death flags, Satou’s suddenly left in the dark when a mysterious stranger returns from the Lily Kingdom-a character she doesn’t recall writing in the original script. Although Yomi claims to be her ally, can Satou really trust a character she knows nothing about in such a dangerous world? (Source: Yen Press)

synopsis: Every girl Rui crushes on confesses to his best friend instead. But can you blame them? His buddy Mia may be a beautiful girl, but she has the bearing and personality of a shojo manga prince, which drives the other girls wild.
